---
title: "Trim and clean alignments of gaps, Ns/low coverage, identicals within species"
output: github_document
date: "2025-03-27"
---

# objectives
* filter/clean nucleotide and protein alignments
	- rm sequences with <50% coverage and >10% ambiguous (export trim_filt)
  - rm identical seqs within each segment and each species/country/year (export nodup_trim_filt)
  - track removed replicated seqs
* count and plot n identical seqs within species

## changes
### 20260108 v2
* purrrify
* fixed issue with mismatches in what was sample-identifying in ncbi and gisaid
  - used gisaid_meta$isolate_id as its sample, before the merge, so then was able to replace entirely use of isolate_name for sample grouping (need to make this change in all related downstream scripts of merge)


### 2025-09-04
* split the _seg and _wg scripts, to focus on data filter based on complete genomes, and removal of identical seqs across whole genome (wg) instead of segment, and within species not species/country/year
* change output folder and objects names; and main files are wg not seg duplicates
* remove redundancy of wg and seg identicals (no longer doing seg identicals)
* fix remaining re-naming issues with host

## to do
* update lookup table of species common names, latin, (and fill in other taxa levels)
* apply the host re-naming to protein meta (or just ignore, b/c can still link back to nuc.meta through sample id)

## helper function: filter a meta df to match fasta headers
```{r}
filter_meta_to_fasta<-function(fasta.file,meta.file,seq_new.col="seq_new"){
  x<-Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fasta.file)
  m<-read.csv(meta.file)
  if(!seq_new.col %in% colnames(m)){
    stop(paste0("Column ",seq_new.col," not found in meta: ",meta.file))
  }
  keep<-m[[seq_new.col]] %in% names(x) #keepers match
  list(nuc = x[names(x) %in% m[[seq_new.col]][keep]],
    meta = m[keep,], 
    missing = m[!keep,])
}

```

## set up fasta and meta, thresholds
```{r}
# remove seq if >10% ambiguous (low qual) or <50% coverage after trimming gaps
min.seq.cov<-0.5
max.seq.ambig<-0.1

# IUPAC ambiguous nuc letters
ambig<-c("N", "B", "D", "H", "V", "K", "Y", "S", "W", "R", "M")

#set up empty lists for nuc and meta to read an element for each segment
nuc.meta<-nuc<-replicate(n=l.seg, vector())
# nuc.meta.rep<-replicate(n=l.seg, vector())
```

## read in the trimmed fasta
```{r}
## read in trimmed fasta AND restrict meta to match what's aligned
missing.meta<-replicate(n=l.seg,vector())

for(i in 1:l.seg){
  tmp<-filter_meta_to_fasta(nuc.fasta.in[i],nuc.meta.in[i],seq_new.col="seq_new")
  nuc[[i]]<-tmp$nuc
  nuc.meta[[i]]<-tmp$meta
  missing.meta[[i]]<-tmp$missing
  stopifnot(length(nuc[[i]])==nrow(nuc.meta[[i]]))

  ## remove nucleotide seqs with too many ambig or too low coverage
  ambig.p<-letterFrequency(nuc[[i]],ambig,as.prob=T)
  gap.p<-letterFrequency(nuc[[i]],"-",as.prob=T)

  too.many.n<-which(ambig.p>max.seq.ambig)
  too.short<-which((1-gap.p)<min.seq.cov)
  rem.short.n<-unique(c(too.many.n,too.short))

  if(length(rem.short.n)>0){
    cut.names<-names(nuc[[i]][rem.short.n])
    metamatch<-which(nuc.meta[[i]]$seq_new %in% cut.names)
    if(length(metamatch)>0){
      nuc.meta[[i]]<-nuc.meta[[i]][-metamatch,] }
    nuc[[i]]<-nuc[[i]][!names(nuc[[i]]) %in% cut.names]
  }

  cat(paste0("Segment ",segments[i],
             ": meta–fasta prefilter mismatch removed = ",
             nrow(tmp$missing),
             "; Ambig > ",max.seq.ambig," = ",length(too.many.n),
             "; Coverage < ",min.seq.cov," = ",length(too.short)),
      file=text.out,sep="\n",append=T)
}

# Checkpoint: export seqs with minimum length and max %N (still has identicals)
for(i in 1:l.seg){
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(nuc[[i]],nuc.fasta.out.filt[i])
  write.csv(nuc.meta[[i]],nuc.meta.out.filt[i],row.names=F)
}
```

## Find identical genomes from the same species:
```{r}
nuc.complete<-nuc[[1]][0] #blank

seg.levels<-segments
meta.key<-nuc.meta.all %>%
  mutate(segment=factor(segment,levels=seg.levels)) %>%
  filter(sample %in% complete.samples) %>%
  arrange(sample,segment)

for(j in 1:length(complete.samples)){
  samp<-complete.samples[j]
  mynuc<-meta.key$seq_new[meta.key$sample==samp]
  
  temp<-replicate(n=l.seg,vector())
  for(i in 1:l.seg){
    hit<-which(names(nuc[[i]])==mynuc[i])
    if(length(hit)!=1){stop(paste0("Missing/duplicate seq_new for sample=",samp," seg=",segments[i]))}
    temp[[i]]<-nuc[[i]][hit]
  }
  fullnuc<-do.call(Biostrings::xscat,temp)
  names(fullnuc)<-samp
  nuc.complete<-c(nuc.complete,fullnuc)
}

length(nuc.complete)
```

# Remove duplicated data
## Find identicals within host (common) species
```{r}
dup<-which(Biostrings::duplicated(nuc.complete))
tot.dup<-length(dup)
tot.dup/length(nuc.complete)

nuc.meta.sample<-data.frame(sample=complete.samples,
replicated=0,n.rep.tot=NA,keep=0,keepID=NA,n.rep=NA,rep.id=NA)

nuc.meta.sample<-left_join(nuc.meta.sample,nuc.meta[[1]][,c("sample","host")],by="sample")

for(j in 1:tot.dup){
  if(nuc.meta.sample$replicated[dup[j]]==1){next}
  same.seqs<-which(nuc.complete==nuc.complete[dup[j]])
  nuc.meta.sample$replicated[same.seqs]<-1
  nuc.meta.sample$n.rep.tot[same.seqs]<-length(same.seqs)
  nuc.meta.sample$rep.id[same.seqs]<-as.character(j)
  nuc.temp<-nuc.meta.sample[same.seqs,] %>% count(host)
  colnames(nuc.temp)[2]<-"n.rep"
  #loop through rows restr to same seqs 
  for(k in 1:nrow(nuc.temp)){
    grp<-which(nuc.meta.sample$host[same.seqs]==nuc.temp$host[k])
    all.nm<-nuc.meta.sample$sample[same.seqs[grp]] %>% sort 
    #TO DO next build: add date, sort by date, and choose seqeunce with earliest detection as most epidemiologically informative
    nuc.meta.sample$keep[which(nuc.meta.sample$sample==all.nm[1])]<-1
    nuc.meta.sample$keepID[which(nuc.meta.sample$sample %in% all.nm)]<-all.nm[1]
    nuc.meta.sample$n.rep[which(nuc.meta.sample$sample %in% all.nm)]<-nuc.temp$n.rep[k]
  }
}

table(nuc.meta.sample$replicated)
table(nuc.meta.sample$keep[nuc.meta.sample$replicated==1])
```

## Remove HA outgroup (not H5) identified in prev build
```{r}
ha.rem<-read.csv(ha.out.in,header=F)
ha.rem<-ha.rem %>% unite("sample",V1,V2)
ha.seg.id<-which(segments=="HA") #need the HA seg to be present for this loop
if(length(ha.seg.id)!=1){stop("HA not found in segments")}
ss.ha<-c()
for(j in 1:nrow(ha.rem)){
  ss<-str_which(nuc.meta[[ha.seg.id]]$seq_new,ha.rem[j,1])
  if(length(ss)>0){
    ss.samp<-nuc.meta[[ha.seg.id]]$sample[ss]
    ss.ha<-c(ss.ha,ss.samp)
  }
}
ss.ha<-unique(ss.ha)

# remove suspect samples from all data
if(length(ss.ha)>0){
  nuc.meta.sample<-nuc.meta.sample %>% filter(!sample %in% ss.ha)
}

#14 samples were removed as suspected not H5
```

## Remove duplicated seqs within species 
```{r}
nuc.meta.wg<-nuc.wg<-replicate(n=l.seg,vector())

nuc.meta.sample<-nuc.meta.sample %>% 
  unite("rep.keep",replicated,keep,remove=F)

nuc.meta.sample.less<-nuc.meta.sample %>%  #the keeprs
  filter(rep.keep!="1_0")
keep.samp<-nuc.meta.sample.less$sample

nuc.meta.sample.rem<-nuc.meta.sample %>%  #the removed ones
  filter(rep.keep=="1_0")
rem.samp<-nuc.meta.sample.rem$sample
remo<-length(rem.samp) #18,448

cat(paste0("N identical genomes within species removed: ",remo),
file=text.out,sep="\n",append=T)

for(i in 1:l.seg){
  nuc.meta.wg[[i]]<-nuc.meta[[i]] %>% filter(sample %in% keep.samp)
  nuc.wg[[i]]<-nuc[[i]][names(nuc[[i]]) %in% nuc.meta.wg[[i]]$seq_new]
  stopifnot(nrow(nuc.meta.wg[[i]])==length(nuc.wg[[i]]))
  
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(nuc.wg[[i]],nuc.fasta.out[i])
  write.csv(nuc.meta.wg[[i]],nuc.meta.out[i],row.names=F)
  
  # nuc.meta.rep[[i]]<-nuc.meta[[i]] %>% filter(sample %in% rem.samp)
  # write.csv(nuc.meta.rep[[i]],nuc.meta.rep.out[i],row.names=F)
}

temp.meta<-bind_rows(nuc.meta.wg)
table.fin<-table(temp.meta$segment)
write.csv(as.data.frame(table.fin),
          paste0(f.out.fig,"n.seq.noambig-lowcov.nodupgenomes-spec.csv"),row.names=F)
write.csv(nuc.meta.sample,
          paste0(f.out.fig,"nuc.meta.sample.summary.csv"),row.names=F)
```

## Plot the number of duplicated genomes
```{r}
# distribution of n.rep and n.rep.tot (histogram)
nuc.meta.sample %>% 
  filter(replicated==1) %>% #only show rep
  filter(keep==1) %>% #one one representative
  ggplot()+
  geom_bar(aes(x=n.rep, fill=host))+
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,20))+
  labs(x="N identical sequences within species", y="N species groups of identical seqs")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "F")+
  plot.theme+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(paste0(f.out.fig,"N_replicated-species.png"), width=7,height=3, units="in")

## plot of n before and after n sequence
temp.df<-nuc.meta.sample %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n.incl.reps=n(),
                   n.reps=length(which(replicated==1)),
                   n.remove=length(which(replicated==1 & keep==0)),
                   n.excl.reps=n.incl.reps-n.remove)
temp.df.l<-temp.df %>% pivot_longer(1:4)
temp.df.l$name<-factor(temp.df.l$name,levels=c("n.incl.reps", "n.reps","n.remove","n.excl.reps"))
temp.df.l %>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_col(aes(y=value,x=name,group=name,fill=name), position="dodge")+
  labs(y="N sequences")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=natparks.pals(name="Yosemite"))+
  plot.theme+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(x=NULL)

ggsave(paste0(f.out.fig,"n.total.removedups.final.png"), width=3,height=3, units="in")
```

## Restrict protmeta and prots to only those in final meta after removals above
```{r}
lookup.prot<-read.csv(lookup.prot.in)

for(i in 1:l.prot){
  l.pro.i<-nrow(prot.meta[[i]])
  prot.keep<-which(prot.meta[[i]]$sample %in% keep.samp)
  prot.meta[[i]]<-prot.meta[[i]][prot.keep,]
  prot[[i]]<-prot[[i]][names(prot[[i]]) %in% prot.meta[[i]]$newname]
  l.pro.f<-nrow(prot.meta[[i]])
  cat(paste0(prot.ord[i]," nrow prot.meta: inital = ",l.pro.i,"; final = ",l.pro.f),
  file=text.out,sep="\n",append=T)
  stopifnot(all(prot.meta[[i]]$newname %in% names(prot[[i]])))
}
```

# Summary of identical frequencies
```{r}
singles<-length(which(nuc.meta.sample.less$replicated==0))
dups<-length(unique(nuc.meta.sample.less$rep.id[nuc.meta.sample.less$replicated==1]))
p.dup<-round(dups/(singles+dups)*100,digits=1)
cat(paste0("Percent duplicated whole genome sequences of cleaned aligns = ",p.dup,"%"),
file=text.out,sep="\n",append=T)

all.meta<-bind_rows(nuc.meta.wg)

all.meta.host<-nuc.meta.sample.less %>%
  filter(replicated==1) %>%
  group_by(rep.id) %>%
  summarize(.groups="drop",
    n.rep.tot=n.rep.tot[1],
    n.host=length(unique(host)),
    hosts=paste(unique(host),collapse=", "))

dup.mult<-length(which(all.meta.host$n.host>1))
p.dup.mult<-round(dup.mult/dups*100,digits=1)
cat(paste0("Percent of duplicated wgs with multiple hosts = ",p.dup.mult,"%"),
file=text.out,sep="\n",append=T)
```

    temp<-nuc.meta.wg[[i]] %>% filter(sample %in% samp[j])
    samp.nuc.wg[[i]]<-nuc.wg[[i]][names(nuc.wg[[i]]) %in% temp$seq_new]
    if(i==1){Biostrings::writeXStringSet(
      samp.nuc.wg[[i]],samp.nuc.fasta.out[j],append=F)}
